messages:
Maya: Morning all — quick async standup:
- What I did: finished staging infra config for autoscaler, validated prefix caching
- Blockers: intermittent rerank flakiness, need help reproducing locally
- Today: monitor canary, triage rerank, prep infra runbook for dedup cache

Jamal: ✅ Took the lead on the autoscaler tests. Saw ~10% tail latency growth on longer seqs in staging. Captured metrics (cpu/gpu swap spikes). Will profile at 11am PT.

Tom: Rolled canary for model v3.2 to 10% with:
```bash
redwood deploy --model v3.2 --canary 10
```
Smoke looks good. Failing: `integration/re-rank.test` — added initial traces to the failing build.

Sophie: Re: rerank flakiness — left comments on the failing test with full logs. @Tom can you drop the exact request payload? suspect tokenization mismatch / padding change.

Tom: Pasted payload to thread: `{ "prompt": "Search results:
1) ...", "max_tokens": 256, "temperature": 0 }` — will also try with quantized weights to rule out numeric drift.

Lena: Quick heads-up: finance needs 2 bullets about Dedicated beta metrics for next week's all-hands. Can someone share by EOD? :memo:

Maya: I can draft bullets by 3pm. Jamal — can you add autoscaler e2e numbers (p95/p99) and cost delta?

InfraBot: staging-deploy-bot: deployment v3.2 canary=10% started at 2155556795. Logs: https://staging.internal/logs/v3.2/canary (tailing).

ProductSyncBot: reminder: product roadmap sync in #product at 16:00 PT. If you have Dedicated beta highlights, add them here: https://docs.redwood/reports/dedicated-beta

Sophie: No other blockers from infra side beyond the rerank test. If anyone can reproduce locally, please DM — I'll pair. :thumbsup:

Tom: I'll try to produce a minimal repro and post it here by noon. If it's a tokenization issue I'll open a small patch PR.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If urgent, ping @oncall or drop an @here. Otherwise we'll reconvene async — will post the Dedicated bullets and the runbook draft later today. :coffee:
